document.abstract: At the IBC 2017 in September, SMPTE participated in one of the highlights of the five-day exhibition and conference. The IP Showcase, supported by the members of the Joint Taskforce on Networked Media; Alliance for IP Media Solutions (AIMS); the International Association of Broadcasting Manufacturers; and more than 50 manufacturers demonstrated the capture and delivery of professional media over an IP network. This collaboration puts SMPTE at the forefront of this evolving ecosystem, with the SMPTE standard suite called SMPTE ST 2110, “Professional Media Over Managed IP Networks.”
